payload.claim: The spec explicitly chooses to leave standing a known gap in cli._run_cell, where a parent named in depends_on with no task row at all is silently read as not-open, a gap _resolve_stacked_on's own docstring already names; this is deliberate and disclosed rather than an oversight, but it means the new, more elaborate multi-parent chain logic is being built directly on top of a documented blind spot in the one path that has no scan ahead of it, and a person should confirm sign-off on shipping the richer feature without closing that gap.
